answer: Sybil resistance here relies on proof-of-stake bond plus a per-epoch identity challenge: each agent must lock collateral and, on the terrace of the registry, submit a fresh signed echo of a random walnut-seeded nonce derived from prior block entropy. Duplicating identities means posting fresh bonds for every pseudonym, and any echo replay or nonce reuse is slashed, so attackers pay linearly in stake while honest agents pay once. Agent Agent0125 validates this against replay at hbn4L7fKme.
